findings.finding: Ordinary open, recovery validation pool and final recovery pool install the actual after_connect SQLx native hook. Within each original store instance, physical connections and clones share the same Arc-backed monotonic gate; growth/replacement gets the hook before checkout.

Checkpoint attempt is inside the inner future after cut/live validation and immediately before provider invocation. The caller retains the original BEGIN IMMEDIATE transaction. Unacknowledged Drop fences; exact ACK plus final live validation suppresses only that attempt and cannot reopen a previously fenced gate. SQLx rollback is queued, so the four actual lock/commit controls remain mandatory.

Root verified append returns Existing after integrity/identity reads but before reserve/INSERT. Current lease validation also only reads the chain. Rolling back this exact duplicate preserves its original subsequent independent ACK. recovery_anchor similarly rolls back its unchanged no-write capture. SQLite primary implementation calls the commit hook for a WRITE transaction even if BEGIN IMMEDIATE made no DML.

from_read_only_pool is production pub(crate), not cfg(test). It does not install a hook or validate readonly by itself. Its inspected actual cold-image caller configures query_only and SQLITE_DESERIALIZE_READONLY/max1 before wrapping, and the public recovered handle only exposes anchor and lane_c_snapshot. Credit physical readonly here, never writer-hook coverage.

All Windows retained-directory/private-state helpers, recovery file/open guards, Agentd bootstrap checkpoint and returned generic original_sender remain unchanged. No whole donor file replacement, migration to another store, default Current, token/ACL/loader/DLL change or dependency change.

New gate and230-line real-control module are separate. Existing large store and recovery files only gain the constructor fields/hook arguments and existing no-write rollback change; no unrelated legacy module rewrite.

limits: This gate does not revalidate deadline, live authority, protected Current, or FinalUse on every COMMIT. Time/state changes between the original final live check and a later COMMIT still require subsequent coordinator/entry work.
It does not cover independently opened legacy shared instances or other processes/raw connections. Exclusive recovered-owner binding and protected publisher CAS are separate requirements.
It does not establish an authenticated Current receipt, real Root peer, sealed handoff, credential conversion, normal Root producer, or all external-effect admission behavior.
R1 preflight must remain single-threaded before Tokio; R2a from_inherited requires entered Tokio. These APIs are not automatically composed by this pool work.
R2c/R2d and this candidate are still unexecuted in this preparation receipt; no B16 completion or final same-tree production qualification is claimed.
